YOUR PRIVACY MATTERS

Privacy Policy.

Last updated: November 7, 2026

This Privacy Policy explains how Bezels handles information when visitors use our website and its anime discovery tools. By using Bezels, you acknowledge the practices described here.

1. Information We Collect

Bezels does not currently require visitors to create an account to use its anime recommendation tools. Information you voluntarily send to us through email may include your email address and the contents of your message.

2. Browser Storage and Watchlist

Our anime finder, quiz and watchlist may use your browser's local storage to remember saved anime and watched titles. This information is stored in your browser on your device. It is not an account-based cloud watchlist and may not transfer to another browser or device. Clearing browser data may remove saved information.

3. How We Use Information

Information voluntarily provided through email may be used to respond to enquiries, understand feedback and improve the website. Browser-stored preferences are used to make the website's tools work as intended.

4. Cookies and Third-Party Services

Bezels may use third-party services for website hosting, analytics, advertising or other functionality in the future. These providers may use cookies or similar technologies according to their own privacy policies.

If advertising services such as Google AdSense are added, they may use cookies to serve, measure and personalise ads where permitted by applicable settings and consent rules. Visitors should review the relevant third-party policies.

5. Third-Party Links

Our website may contain links to external websites or services. Bezels does not control the privacy practices or content of those websites. We encourage visitors to read their policies before sharing information.

6. Data Security

We take reasonable steps to maintain the website and protect information shared with us. However, no method of internet transmission or electronic storage can be guaranteed to be completely secure.

7. Children's Privacy

Bezels is intended for a general audience of anime fans. We do not knowingly request personal information from children through our recommendation tools. Parents or guardians who have concerns about information submitted to us can contact us.

8. Changes to This Policy

We may update this Privacy Policy when our website, features or practices change. Updated information will be published on this page with a revised date.

9. Contact Us

If you have questions about this Privacy Policy, contact us atmbilalvxl@gmail.com.
